name: Juniper Ridge Coffee Roasters
tagline: Small-batch coffee, roasted in the foothills.
about: Juniper Ridge is a fictional demo company. We roast single-origin coffee in small batches every Tuesday and Friday, and run one café beside the roastery.

items.name: Espresso
items.description: A double shot of the current single origin.

items.name: Cortado
items.description: Equal parts espresso and steamed milk.

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Espresso with a deep layer of foam.

items.name: Latte
items.description: Whole milk, or oat or almond for $0.75 more.

items.name: Mocha
items.description: Espresso, dark chocolate and steamed milk.

items.name: Juniper honey latte
items.description: House juniper syrup and Utah honey.

items.name: Pour-over
items.description: Any single origin on the shelf, brewed to order.

items.name: Breakfast burrito
items.description: Egg, potato, cheddar and green chile.

faqs.question: Do you ship?
faqs.answer: Yes, within the United States. Orders placed by noon on a roast day ship the same day.

faqs.question: Do you offer decaf?
faqs.answer: Yes, a Swiss Water Process decaf from Colombia.
